title: Affine-invariant Cubic Newton with Weak Learners
abstract: arXiv:2610.33516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern gradient boosting algorithms are based on Newton's method, which excels empirically but lacks global convergence guarantees. While recent work on Gradient-Regularized Newton (GRN) boosting achieved a global $\mathcal{O}(1/\gamma^{12}k^2)$ rate, its analysis was not able to exploit the natural Hessian geometry and suffers from a heavy $\gamma^{12}$ dependence on a worst-case `weak gradient edge' $\gamma$. In this paper, we tackle these theoretical drawbacks by generalizing the Affine-Invariant Cubic Newton (AICN) scheme to convex optimization with weak learners. Our analysis is based on average cosine values $\overline{\Theta}_k$ along the optimization path and directional improvements $\delta_k$ in the Hessian-induced norm. We show that the weak-AICN update reduces to a damped weak-Newton step with an explicit stepsize determined by $\delta_k$. tldr: 本文将仿射不变三次牛顿法（AICN）推广到带弱学习器的凸优化，通过平均余弦值和Hessian诱导范数下的方向改进量进行分析，克服了GRN提升算法对弱梯度边界参数的 γ¹² 重度依赖，建立了更优的全局收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes the Affine-Invariant Cubic Newton (AICN) scheme to convex optimization with weak learners, exploiting average cosine values and directional improvements in the Hessian-induced norm to overcome the heavy γ¹² dependence of GRN boosting and establish improved global convergence rates under semi-strong self-concordance.
